nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus infection in China. 
Prevention strategies: 
1. Hand washing
2.  Avoiding touching and sharing possibly infected items.
3.Avoid gatherings.
4. Infected patients must exercise social distancing.
5. At-risk patients should exercise precautions.

nodes.author: Parvaizkoul
nodes.text: There is no specific treatment for the virus and no vaccinations. So symptom based management is the way forward.
